products.name: ProShield Architectural
products.short_description: Architectural laminate shingles with a dimensional profile and balanced curb appeal.
products.long_description: A versatile architectural shingle offering dimensional shadows, an algae-resistance package, and a wide color palette. Suitable for most residential roof styles.

products.name: AeroGuard Premium
products.short_description: Premium designer shingles with a deeper shadow line and high wind resistance.
products.long_description: Designer-class shingles featuring an enhanced shadow profile, premium granule blends, and an upgraded warranty. Engineered for severe weather zones.

products.name: StormCrest Elite
products.short_description: Impact-rated shingles for hail-prone regions with reinforced backing.
products.long_description: UL 2218 Class 4 impact-rated shingles built for hail-prone regions. Reinforced backing and a polymer-modified binder help limit storm damage.

products.name: ClimateLock Designer
products.short_description: Cool-roof designer shingles engineered to reflect more of the sun's heat.
products.long_description: Reflective granule technology helps reduce attic heat gain in warm climates. Designer profile available in earth-tone palettes.

products.name: HeritageLine Three-Tab
products.short_description: Classic three-tab shingles for budget-friendly residential projects.
products.long_description: Time-tested three-tab profile for budget-friendly roofs and rental properties. Easy to install and broadly available.

products.name: VistaPeak Impact
products.short_description: Heavy-weight impact shingles with a deep architectural profile.
products.long_description: Heavy-weight architectural shingles built around an impact-resistant SBS-modified core. Ideal for higher-end retrofits.
